text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …It's starting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega mutters next to me. Then, a roar of cheers fill the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: First up is number seven, T.M. Opera O! She's the clear favorite with her insurmountable number of fans!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Looks like a bump's starting to swell where she hit her head just moments ago. But that won't be a problem for her. She's as strong as a rock!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What did she get herself into this time?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And who comes to mind when you think of T.M. Opera O? It's Meisho Doto, number thirteen! Will our second most popular contender finally achieve victory?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Her skills sure have been improving at an incredible rate. Will she be able to best the Overlord?! Make sure you keep your eyes on her!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why can't she keep her chin up? Listen to how well they're talking about her.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And finally, it's the Umamusume you've all been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm Narita Top Road! I'll try my best to win your support!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Top Road! It's Top Roooad!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Aw! I'm so glad you're running in the Arima Kinen! I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Listen to those cheers! Number four, Narita Top Road, is our third most popular!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: She may have missed the Japan Cup, but her indomitable go-getter attitude makes you want to cheer her on! I have high hopes for her!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's head to the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Arima Kinen gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O pushes up to first place from eleventh by a nose after crossing through a persistent pack in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild at the Opera Overlord's display of fierce determination. Her rival, Meisho Doto, makes it to second place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally… Narita Top Road takes ninth place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: …I lost!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I know, I saw it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… um… Sorry, that was embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But, well, I'm still growing and improving, so it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So I'm bound to keep embarrassing myself as I struggle and struggle—as I keep trying my hardest… harder than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll keep going until the day I can beat Opera O, Doto, and you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I won't let my fans down! Because I'm Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Okay.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If you're going to be like that, then let me say something too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Rise up… and meet my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I will!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As the Arima Kinen draws to a close, so too does the year… and a new season begins.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, y-yes… um… Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Our era is nowhere near over.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That goes for all of us—you, Ayabe, myself… even Top Road.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's compete again, as many times countable—for we are an unending quartet!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The radiance of our four stars will shine bright, even in the light of day.
